description:
Get the download link for a completed audience run. Returns a presigned URL the user can click to download their contact list.

RENDERING — MANDATORY, VERBATIM:
The response contains a download link already formatted as a markdown link with an angle-bracket destination: [Download ...](<https://...>). Present it exactly as returned. Keep the angle brackets around the URL, do NOT percent-encode or decode any query parameters, and do NOT drop, reorder, or truncate any parameter — every response-content-* and X-Amz-* param must be preserved byte-for-byte. Do NOT rewrite it into a code block, a bare URL, or an HTML anchor; emit the markdown link as the backend sent it.

runId.description: The runId returned by audience_start_run or check_payment

name: audience_download_run
